title: October 14, 2010: India finished 2nd on a Commonwealth Games medal table for the first time ever.

sources.text: Al Jazeera - Commonwealth Games end in New Delhi

caption:
October 14, 2010: India finished 2nd on a Commonwealth Games medal table for the first time ever.

India finished with 38 gold medals and 101 medals in total, moving ahead of England for the first time in the event's history - achieved on home soil, at a Games India itself had built the venues for.

Saina Nehwal saved a match point in the women's badminton singles final to beat Malaysia's Wong Mew Choo, pushing India's gold count past England's at the closing bell.

Finishing 2nd at a Games it organized showed India could build the venues, run the logistics and still perform - hosting capability and athletic capability arriving together.
